Full Digital Control. The Portafilter is a fully analog, dual-programmable overdrive that’s built for total customization. Run the two sides set to the same, set up two completely different voices for maximum contrast, or stack and shape until you’ve built something entirely your own. With an intuitive interface, savable presets, and full MIDI control, the Portafilter combines analog warmth with modern flexibility—making it as easy to recall your sounds as it is to create them. Watch Demo Video × Iconic Drives at Your Fingertips Each side of the Portafilter features Tubescreamer, Bluesbreaker, and Klon styles, letting you mix, match, and stack legendary overdrives. Dial in everything from subtle boosts to roaring crunch, and combine both sides for layered tones that feel like a full studio mix — all from one pedal. Two Fully Customizable Sides Each drive circuit comes with a 3-band EQ and selectable clipping, giving you total control over your tone. Program the sides independently for versatile setups, or sync them for a stacked dual-drive sound. The pedal adapts to your style, whether you want transparent grit, classic rhythm, or lead-focused punch. Instant Visual Feedback Bright LED pushbuttons display which overdrive, EQ mids, and clipping option is active, making it easy to see exactly how your tone is configured at a glance. When in preset mode, the LEDs will light up white to show you which preset is active. Presets & Full MIDI Control The Portafilter remembers every move you make — every knob twist, every toggle flip. Store six tones onboard, or expand to 20 with MIDI. Every parameter is MIDI-controllable, so your pedalboard becomes part of a larger, automated performance rig. more features full midi control Take full control of knobs, presets, switches and settings - all over midi. presets Save and recall 6 of your favorite sounds by using both footswitches (up to 20 via midi). hard clipping Add extra distortion after your overdrive for more saturation, sustain, and compression.
